name: Ultimate GD Toolbox
description: Precision frame tools; compatibility test build for Ultimate GD Toolbox.

show-hud.name: Show frame HUD
show-hud.description: Show the live precision frame counter during gameplay.

tps.name: Timing ticks per second
tps.description: Internal timing resolution. Stock Geometry Dash timing is normally measured at 240 ticks per second.

window-size.name: Window size
window-size.description: Number of timing ticks used by the live window monitor.

sound-enabled.name: Frame sounds
sound-enabled.description: Play the bundled marker sound when the live window boundary is reached.

sound-volume.name: Frame sound volume
sound-volume.description: Volume of the frame marker sound.
